d: Country of Egypt scourged by the rays of the sun with ancient stone bridge over a branch of the Nile. Julius Caesar. Curiosity, passing the bridge.
Achilles with numerous Egyptian mats loaded with aurei kisses.
Curio. Sixth. Cornelia, who returns to himself.
Cleopatra's room. Cleopatra under canopy real. Rodisbe.
Districts of the cesarean camp with the urn in the middle, which encloses the ashes of the head of Pompey the Great above eminent pile of warrior trophies. Julius Caesar. After Curio.
Cleopatra in bridesmaid's dress. Rodisbe. Nireno. Julius Caesar. Curio.
Cornelia. Said aside... after Sixth, who survives.

Atrium of the royal palace of the Ptolemies with competition of the People. At the sound of the trumpets precede Egyptian and Roman Knights. Julius Caesar. Achilles. After Ptolemy, who comes to meet him.
Gallery. Cleopatra, what thoughtful is sitting at a thorn.
Julius Caesar. Cleopatra inside. Nireno aside.
Garden of the seraglio, where the fairs correspond. Achilles. Nireno.
Cornelia, who with a hoe petiola in her hands is growing flowers. Achilles. Nireno in the background.
As Cornelia flees, she meets Ptolemy, who takes her to the right.
As Cornelia runs to hurricane herself into the seraglio of the fairs, Sixth comes in an eunuch's dress, which holds her back. After Rodisbe.
Loco of delights, Cleopatra in her royal dress, after Nireno.
Julius Caesar, Cleopatra, pretending to be asleep.
Bathrooms of the seraglio. Cornelia in the eunuch's dresses of Sesto. Sixth in woman's dress in Cornelia's robes. Rodisbe.
Ptolemy surrounded by the women of his favorite seraglio led by Rodisbe. Sixth, who pretending to cry is covering his face with a handkerchief.
While Sixtus goes to hold Ptolemy's sword to conceal it, he is prevented by Achilles, who takes it, and makes it to Ptolemy. Rodisbe.
Riviera of the port of Alexandria illuminated in time of night, where it follows naval battle, and terrestrial. With People spectator. Cleopatra. Ptolemy in warrior dress over armed ships.
Ptolemy, who lands with all his Gentiles. Cleopatra prisoner with many other Knights of his confederates. Nireno.
Cornelia, who is in a warrior's habit, and covered with helmets leaps out of the army of the Knights who are prisoners of Cleopatra.
Curio, Julius Caesar unnoticed. Achilles lying on the edge of the mortally wounded harbor. Cornelia, and Nireno in progress to leave.
Julius Caesar, who kidnaps Cornelia's seal.
Ptolemy, who met Rodisbe, brings her back with him.
While Ptolemy is in the act of piercing Sesto, Curio arrives, who suddenly raises his brando. Said. After a touch of trumpet Julius Caesar with numerous Schiere.
Royal Hall. Julius Caesar. Cleopatra. Cornelia. Curio. Sixth.
